title: AeroFriends
body:
# 👥 AeroFriends | Authentic Hypixel-Style Friend System

AeroFriends is a highly optimized, fully customizable Minecraft server plugin that delivers an authentic **Hypixel** friend system experience. Built with performance and clean aesthetics in mind, it allows your players to seamlessly connect, track, and manage their in-game social circle.

Developed by **Aero's Creations**, this plugin features a signature deep blue color palette, real-time activity tracking, and dynamic dual-sided notifications.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🔹 **Authentic Hypixel Aesthetic:** Clean, beautifully formatted chat dividers (`&9&m------------------`) and layout copies that match the industry standard.
* 🔹 **Live Status & Location Tracking:** The friend list automatically tracks if a player is online and dynamically displays their active world/server node (e.g., `■ Player is in SkyBlock`).
* 🔹 **Interactive Chat Menus:** Typing just `/f` or `/friend` displays an interactive text layout with hoverable and clickable actions (`[ACCEPT]` / `[DENY]`) for friend requests.
* 🔹 **Smart Two-Way Removal Alerts:** When a player removes a friend (individually or via `/f removeall`), **both** screens are updated. The target player instantly receives a notification that they were removed.
* 🔹 **Robust Request Toggling:** Players can toggle incoming requests on or off. If disabled, incoming invites are completely blocked instantly.
* 🔹 **Soft PlaceholderAPI Support:** Works flawlessly out of the box using standard native `%player_name%` placeholders. If PlaceholderAPI is present on your server, it will automatically hook into it to parse custom prefixes, suffixes, and ranks without requiring it as a hard dependency!

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf6f147f26069bca44a20bb62bb2daced6f68463.jpeg)

| Command | Description | Permission | Aliases |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/friend` | Displays the help options menu in chat | `aerofriends.use` | `/f`, `/friends` |
| `/friend add <name>` | Sends a friend request to a player | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend accept <name>` | Accepts a pending friend request | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend deny <name>` | Declines a pending friend request | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend remove <name>` | Removes a player from your friend list | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend removeall` | Clears your entire friend list with dual notifications | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend list [page]` | Lists your friends, showing their online server/world | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend toggle` | Enables/Disables incoming friend requests | `aerofriends.use` | |

---

## 📊 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)

If you have PlaceholderAPI installed, you can use these extensions anywhere on your server (Scoreboards, Tabs, Chat):

* `%friends_total%` - Total number of friends added.
* `%friends_online%` - Number of currently online friends.
* `%friends_offline%` - Number of offline friends.
* `%friends_limit%` - Maximum allowed friend limit.

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Drop the `AeroFriends 1.0.0.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server to generate the configuration files.
3. *(Optional)* Install **PlaceholderAPI** to unlock advanced rank/prefix integrations inside the friend notifications.
4. Enjoy a premium, seamless network experience!
